lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three distinct horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible. The median row contains approximately six nodes with regular spatial intervals, while the row immediately ventral displays larger, more diffuse clusters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a visible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two primary horizontal ridges are visible across the flank; one is positioned near the anterior dorsal fin base and a second runs parallel below it, both exhibiting high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, distinct notch is visible on the trailing (posterior) edge of the dorsal fin, located approximately halfway between the base and the apex. A small white focal point is visible on the dorsal surface posterior to the fin.
